title: Carry a rejected job's request and findings into a retry reading
summary: When the request is "try again on <job>", Athena resolves that rejected job and gives the reader its request text and final verifier findings in a new "Earlier attempt" brief section. The new job's own request stays as typed.

defaults_applied.how: Unit and lifecycle tests cover the new section and the refusal cases.
One focused change across the brief, the resolver, and the docs.
Carried request and findings text goes through the redactor.
README and CHANGELOG document the new form.
Behavior criteria use cargo test, clippy, and fmt --check.

assumptions: The form is matched case-insensitively at the start of the request: 'try again on <job-id>'.
Only rejected jobs can be retried; landed, unknown, or in-flight jobs are refused with an error naming the job and its state.
The earlier findings are those of the job's final verification record.
Carried text is redacted before it reaches the brief.

acceptance_criteria.text: ReaderInputs in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs gains an optional earlier-attempt field (job id, request text, findings). reader_brief renders it as its own quoted section only when present; output without it is unchanged.

A function in athena-core detects 'try again on <job>', resolves the job, and builds the attempt from that job's request record and final verification findings. It refuses a job that is not rejected, or that lacks a request or verification, with an error naming the job and its state.
read_for and first_reading in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs pass the attempt to reader_brief, and the carried text goes through the redactor.
README.md and CHANGELOG.md mention the 'try again on <job>' form.
Run `cargo test`: a unit test in briefs.rs shows the brief contains the earlier request and findings when set and lacks the section when unset.

Run `cargo test`: a lifecycle test with the fake driver rejects a job, then asks 'try again on <id>' and shows the reader brief includes that job's request and findings. Another test shows a landed or unknown job is refused.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.

out_of_scope: Changing how the verifier or producer work on retries
Automatically retrying without the user asking
departures: Small departure: the change spans two crates plus tests and docs, so I raised cost and time slightly above the reference.
